name: Gert-Rudolf Flick
current_role: Private investor, art historian and collector; visiting professor in the history of art, University of Buckingham (as of 2019)
profile: Grandson of German industrialist Friedrich Flick, born 1943; holds a law doctorate from LMU Munich. Joined the Flick firm in 1971 and, with his siblings, sold his stake in 1975, the source of his wealth. Since then he has lived in London as an art historian, author and collector of Italian old masters and vedute.
interesting_fact: He was publisher of Apollo, the London fine-art magazine, in the 1990s, and kept a collection of early silver and Italian vedute, including a Canaletto of fireworks over Venice, at Park House, Kensington.
deep_cut_fact: He wrote 'Missing Masterpieces: Lost Works of Art 1450-1900' (2003), a study of lost artworks, and 'Masters & Pupils' (2008), which traces an 'apostolic succession' of teacher-pupil training through European art history.
notes: Very private; no published personal or office contacts found. Probably best reached through the University of Buckingham's art history department. Not in energy or data centres, so a weak fit for the podcast. I could not confirm recent activity, so 'alive' is set to unknown (no death report found). His family history is a sensitive topic.

name: Shen Jiansheng
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Yinbang Clad Material Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300337), Wuxi
profile: Shen Jiansheng (沈健生) is co-controlling shareholder, with Shen Yulan, of Yinbang Clad Material, one of China's largest makers of aluminium clad plate, strip and foil for brazing. Its products go mainly into heat exchangers for cars and home appliances. The company listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2012, and he still runs it as chairman and GM; he sat on the board as recently as April 2026.
interesting_fact: Yinbang is among China's largest producers of aluminium brazing clad materials. These are the sheets inside car radiators and air-conditioner heat exchangers, a supply chain that also matters for thermal management in EVs and data centres.
deep_cut_fact: In August 2023 he led Yinbang to Aluminium Stewardship Initiative Performance Standard certification for its Wuxi plant, saying 'We are pleased to pass the ASI Performance Standard certification.' He framed it as a step toward green, low-carbon and digital management.

public_contacts.value: Investor Q&A via the Panorama (全景网) investor relations interactive platform, as stated in company notices; board secretary Gu Yiming handles investor communication

notes: Low public profile. The company website (yinbang.com) was access-restricted from here. The published IR email and phone are in the company's annual reports on cninfo.com.cn. Heat-exchanger materials give an angle into energy and data-centre cooling.

name: Lin Kaiwen
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO (legal representative), Shanghai Kaiquan Pump (Group) Co., Ltd.
profile: Lin Kaiwen (林凯文) founded Shanghai Kaiquan Pump in the mid-1990s; it was registered in July 1996 and is headquartered in Jiading, Shanghai. It grew into one of China's largest private pump groups, designing and making pumps, water-supply equipment and pump control systems. He has been on Hurun's China rich list every year since 2006 and still leads the group.
interesting_fact: Kaiquan sells through its own direct-sales model and has been recognised as a 'National Enterprise Technology Centre', claiming more than 700 technology patents. Large pumps like its products run municipal water, power plants and cooling systems.
notes: Very low media profile; I found no interviews. The company site (kaiquan.com.cn) did not load from here. Note that kaiquan.com is a different, unrelated pump company. Pumps for power plants and cooling are a possible energy/data-centre angle. Data aggregators disagree on the founding year (1995 vs 1996).

name: Jin Ming
current_role: Former President of Suning Appliance / Suning Commerce Group (2010 to about 2015); current role not publicly known
profile: Jin Ming (金明) is a long-time Suning executive who joined founder Zhang Jindong's appliance retailer in 1993, became a director and shareholder, and in July 2010 replaced Sun Weimin as president. He was widely seen as a possible successor to Zhang. His wealth comes from his Suning shareholding; he was on the Hurun China list from 2007 to 2011.
interesting_fact: He spent his whole early career at Suning, joining straight out of university in 1993 when it was still a Nanjing air-conditioner retailer, and rose to president of what became one of China's largest electronics retailers.
deep_cut_fact: He joined Suning in 1993 straight after graduating, three years after Zhang Jindong founded it as a single air-conditioner shop in Nanjing, and in July 2010 succeeded Sun Weimin as company president.
notes: In January 2015 there were reports, which Suning disputed, that he had stepped down as president; I found nothing public about him since. No personal channels. Suning.com's IR office is the only institutional route, and he may no longer be connected to it. A common name, so double-check identity before any outreach.

name: Kamal Khetan
current_role: Chairman and Managing Director, Sunteck Realty Ltd (NSE/BSE listed, Mumbai)
profile: Kamal Khetan holds an electronics and communication engineering degree from Mangalore University. He started out leasing office space and running business centres in Mumbai's Bandra Kurla Complex, then founded the Sunteck group around 2000. He built it into a luxury and mass-premium developer (Signature Island at BKC, Sunteck City at ODC Goregaon) and has since taken the brand to Dubai.
interesting_fact: He started investing in equities in the late 1980s, right after engineering, with early blue chips like Reliance and Tata stocks. He calls himself 'an aggressive businessman and an equally aggressive investor' who holds stocks for four to six years.
deep_cut_fact: He invests only when three tests are met: good sector, good company, good management. He once said: 'I am a long-term investor and a strong believer that patience does pay off.' He keeps a small part of his portfolio in art, which he treats as a passion rather than an investment (Outlook Business, 2018).
notes: Input record's name_chinese (纳拉亚娜·穆尔蒂 = Narayana Murthy) is a data error; ignore it. Sunteck's VP Strategy and IR is Abhishek Shukla. Khetan appears regularly in Indian business media, so he is reachable through the company's corporate communications team.

name: Chen Yuanfen
current_role: Shareholder (top-10, about 0.3%) of Shenzhen Hongtao Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002325); no executive or board role
profile: Chen Yuanfen (陈远芬) appears on Hurun China 2021 together with Liu Nianxin (刘年新), founder-chairman of Shenzhen Hongtao Decoration (now Hongtao Group), a public-building interior-fit-out contractor for theatres, libraries, hotels and stadiums. She is a top-10 shareholder of the company but holds no board or management role, and her relationship to Liu is not stated in public filings.
interesting_fact: Hongtao began in 1985 as a state-owned Shenzhen decoration engineering firm. It was privatised in 2003 under Liu Nianxin and listed in 2009, specialising in fit-outs for theatres, conference halls and stadiums.
notes: Web search quota ran out partway through this lane, so the information comes from Sina Finance company and shareholder pages. Hongtao is now under *ST special treatment and is in financial difficulty, so the Hurun wealth figure is likely out of date. Liu Nianxin (born 1956) is the chairman and the more relevant contact. Chen Yuanfen keeps a very low profile.

name: He Zhitao
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Hangzhou Lianluo Interactive Information Technology (SZSE: 002280); Chairman, Newegg Commerce
profile: He Zhitao (何志涛), born 1982, holds a master's degree and controls Hangzhou Lianluo (Liaison) Interactive, a Shenzhen-listed mobile-internet and IT e-commerce company. In 2016 Lianluo acquired a majority stake in US computer-hardware e-tailer Newegg, and Wikipedia lists He as Newegg's chairman. Newegg later went public on Nasdaq through a 2021 merger.
interesting_fact: His Hangzhou company took majority control of Newegg, one of America's best-known PC-parts retailers, in 2016, an unusual Chinese takeover of a US e-commerce brand that makes him a link between Chinese tech and the US hardware-enthusiast market.
deep_cut_fact: Before Lianluo he was VP and COO of LinkWell and CEO of Beijing Kubao Network Technology (北京酷宝网络科技), and served as a director of E.T.Xun (Hong Kong) Holding and E.T.Xun Holding Inc. He became Lianluo's general manager in January 2015, aged about 32.
notes: Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings pages and Wikipedia. Lianluo currently trades as 'ST联络' (special-treatment status). Newegg (Nasdaq: NEGG) investor relations is another institutional route. Strong fit for the data-centre / PC-hardware angle through Newegg.

name: Zhao Jizeng
current_role: Founder and former Chairman, Beijing Lirr High-temperature Materials Co. (SZSE: 002392); his son Zhao Wei has been chairman since July 2024
profile: Zhao Jizeng (赵继增), born 1955, is a professor-level senior engineer and former executive vice-president of the Ministry of Metallurgy's Luoyang Institute of Refractories Research. In 2000 he founded Beijing Lier (now Lirr) Refractory Materials, which supplies refractories and full-service furnace-lining contracts to steel, non-ferrous, petrochemical and building-materials plants. It listed in Shenzhen in 2010.
interesting_fact: He is a scientist-turned-founder: he won a National Spark Program science and technology award and eight ministerial/provincial S&T awards, and was named a national advanced science and technology worker before leaving a state research institute to start his own refractories company.
deep_cut_fact: He was one of the first startup mentors in Zhongguancun's 'Golden Seed Project' (金种子工程), sits on the board of and teaches part-time at Wuhan University of Science and Technology, and serves on the council of the World Refractories Association (WRA).
notes: Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings pages. His board role after July 2024 is unconfirmed (Zhao Wei is now chairman). Refractories for steel furnaces give an angle on heavy-industry energy use and decarbonisation.

name: Zhao Hanxin
current_role: Co-founder and former Chairman (2008 to 2016) and director (to October 2020), Wuxi New Hongtai Electrical Technology Co. (SSE: 603016)
profile: Zhao Hanxin (赵汉新), born October 1953, is an engineer and senior economist from Yanqiao, Wuxi. He ran local micro-motor factories from 1984 and then founded Xishan Hongtai, later New Hongtai, which makes key circuit-breaker components, low-voltage breakers, BMC moulded insulation parts and fuse switches. He took it public in Shanghai in 2016 and left the board in 2020.
interesting_fact: New Hongtai, the company he co-founded with Zhao Minhai and others, makes the moulded insulating parts and mechanisms inside low-voltage circuit breakers, basic components of power distribution in buildings and data centres.
deep_cut_fact: He started in 1973 as a technician at the micro-motor factory run by Yanqiao Middle School in Wuxi, and spent 11 years there before becoming director of the Wuxi County micro-motor factory in 1984.
notes: Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings. He has not been on the board since October 2020. Ding Kui has been chairman since December 2023, which suggests control may have changed; Zhao Minhai (vice-chairman and GM) is co-listed. Born 1953; I found no recent news of him.
